name: Action for Happiness (Founders Pledge, 2020)
summary: Eight-week 'Exploring What Matters' courses on wellbeing, run by volunteers, mostly in the UK. A re-implementation of Founders Pledge's 2020 cost-effectiveness analysis of funding Action for Happiness' scale-up, in DALY-equivalents of depression averted.

sections.title: Discounting
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Founders Pledge's. Founders Pledge discounts future participants for uncertainty and for other funders, but not for time. In our view later years count less at the discount rate under Your values; Founders Pledge's view sets it to 0, so its numbers reproduce.

sections.title: Our steps: per dollar, and staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' steps after Founders Pledge's bottom line: the cost per outcome turned into outcomes per dollar, then credit by share of resources (staff's forgone pay), which is off by default and in Founders Pledge's view.

rows.label: DALY weighting per point on the PHQ-9 scale (healthy years per point-year)
rows.explainer: Changed for consistency. Founders Pledge divides the weight of severe depression by the middle of the severe band (0.658 / 23.25 = 0.0283 per point, 'Main CEA'!C6). The site counts every fall in depression on the PHQ-9 the same way, for every model: 0.031 healthy years per point for a year, the Global Burden of Disease weights for mild, moderate and severe depression placed on the PHQ-9's severity bands (shared fact). The evaluator view uses Founders Pledge's 0.0283.

rows.label: Yearly discount rate for the uncertainty of the projection

source.title: Founders Pledge, Action for Happiness cost-effectiveness analysis (2020)

rows.explainer: Founders Pledge discounts each later year of projected participants, continuously, for the chance the projection is wrong. Not a time preference: our discount rate is applied on top in our view. Its own range (optimistic 5%, conservative 27.5%).

rows.label: Yearly discount rate for the chance another funder pays for the scale-up

source.title: Founders Pledge, Action for Happiness cost-effectiveness analysis (2020)

rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's yearly discount, continuously, for the chance that someone else would have funded the growth anyway, so later participants are less due to this money. Its own range.

rows.label: Discount for other funders, as applied
rows.explainer: A funging step: with credit by share of resources on, money from other funders isn't subtracted from this donation's credit, so the discount is 0 (the ongoing running costs and volunteers' time that would then belong in the cost aren't counted; see the write-up). Off, Founders Pledge's rate.

rows.label: Total extra course participants through scale-up funding
rows.formula: planning_accuracy * (exp(-(forecast_decay + time_discount)) * extra_participants_2020 + exp(-(forecast_decay + time_discount) * 2) * extra_participants_2021 + exp(-(forecast_decay + time_discount) * 3) * extra_participants_2022 + extra_participants_2023_on * exp(-time_discount * 3) * (exp(-(other_funder_rate + time_discount)) + exp(-(other_funder_rate + time_discount) * 2) + exp(-(other_funder_rate + time_discount) * 3) + exp(-(forecast_decay + other_funder_rate + time_discount) * 3) / (exp(forecast_decay + other_funder_rate + time_discount) - 1)))
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's sum of the extra participants in each future year, each year discounted continuously at its forecast and other-funder rates, with the years from 2026 on summed to infinity. Our time discount is added to every rate, and the yearly extra participants from 2023 on are discounted three more years for when they come (Founders Pledge starts its other-funder discount in 2023); it is 0 in Founders Pledge's view, so the sheet reproduces.

rows.label: GBP to USD

source.title: Founders Pledge, Action for Happiness cost-effectiveness analysis (2020)

rows.explainer: Changed for consistency. Founders Pledge converts the pound budget at the rate of 1 December 2019, 1.2911 dollars per pound. The site converts every pound figure at the IRS yearly average rate for the year the money is spent (shared fact), so that the same pound counts the same in every model: here 2020, when the scale-up funding starts (1.2837). The evaluator view uses Founders Pledge's 1.2911.

rows.label: Budgeted scale-up funding (USD)
Cost per DALY-equivalent averted (USD)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's bottom line in the 2020 sheet: $2,770 per DALY-equivalent ($177–30,778 across its optimistic and conservative cases).

rows.label: Cost per year of severe major depressive disorder prevented (USD)
Cost per happiness point-year gained (USD)
Cost per life satisfaction point-year gained (USD)
rows.explainer: Labelled life satisfaction in the sheet ($188 per point-year), but its input is the happiness result (labels swapped), so $188 is per happiness point-year and life satisfaction is the row above ($197). Founders Pledge's 2022 summary page gives $137 per WELLBY from a later estimate with no published model; this model reproduces the 2020 sheet.

rows.label: Discount rate on future benefits
rows.explainer: The shared discount rate (Your values). Founders Pledge doesn't discount these benefits, so its view pins the rate at 0.

rows.label: Discount factor on benefits that fade year by year
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge counts a benefit that keeps a fixed share of itself each year (the retention rate), summed over all years, without discounting. Discounting each year's benefit at the shared rate turns the sum 1 / (1 − r) into 1 / (1 − r / (1 + rate)); this is the ratio of the two. At a rate of 0 it is 1, so Founders Pledge's figures reproduce.

rows.label: Same rate, compounded continuously
rows.explainer: The yearly rate as a continuous rate, added to Founders Pledge's continuous yearly discounts on future participants.

rows.label: DALY-equivalents averted per dollar
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's cost per DALY-equivalent turned around.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs where staff deliver the help themselves (here, staff who build and support a network of volunteer-led courses): staff pay is about half the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen the scale-up budget's breakdown. Volunteers' unpaid time is not counted.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Charity staff often earn somewhat less than in comparable jobs. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: DALY-equivalents averted per donor dollar
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).
